raw_content: The 2024 NICE Actimize Fraud Insights report explores industry-wide fraud trends, highlighting what poses the most risk for your financial institution and customers. Unlock critical insights with this comprehensive analysis, developed by data scientists and fraud experts using NICE Actimizes collective intelligence.Whats InsideIncreased Fraud Attempts: Fraud attempt volumes rose year-over-yearEnhanced Controls in Action: Stronger fraud prevention measures have led to a decline in P2P fraud by volumeRising Threats: Authorized fraud is surging, with romance and investment scams skyrocketing by value, respectivelyImpactful Regulation: Anecdotal evidence shows new UK regulation has caused fraudsters to resort to slower payment typesPersistent Check Fraud: Fraudsters are adapting, using established accounts to bypass controls on new accountsRead the industry insight
